_comment: Visual layout for departures.py. Edit text lines, fonts, colours and positions here, then rerun -- no code changes needed. Pitch bases (tight/tight_mid) are derived live from the font metrics (height - 2); the *_dy / gap values below are added on top. y positions are text baselines (DrawText convention).

fonts._comment: BDF files in ./fonts (or absolute paths). Roles: top = page-1 lead service, row = other services, small = calling-at/notes/clock, big = page-2 headline, tiny = page numbers + 1ST markers.

colors._comment: R,G,B. text = default orange, time/platform = yellow, ok/alert = status, mark = marker knockout.

page1._comment: Board: lead service (top font) + calling-at, then compact rows. top_dy shifts the lead baseline vs the font baseline; calling_dy/call gaps are added to the metric pitch.

page2._comment: Next departure big: headline (big font), status line, note line. dest_dy lifts the destination vs the time; status_dy/note_dy are relative line pitches.

page3._comment: Formation diagram: fixed-width coach cards, left-aligned. boxes_dy offsets the cards below the header baseline; labels_dy offsets letters below the cards.

clock._comment: Live clock, centered, pinned to the bottom (dy from screen height).

page_num._comment: n/3 indicator, bottom-right tiny font (dy from screen height).

progress._comment: Page-flip progress bar, right-aligned above the page number (dy from screen height).
